title: Matt Citron kindles a firestorm with new anthem "Rip The Roof Off”
htmlContent: "Rip The Roof Off" by Atlanta's Matt Citron sounds like an explosion due to its blend of rap, rock, and electronic music. This song hits hard from the first beat, sending a shockwave through your bones that makes you pay attention, and Matt knows that this song is for the end of an action movie. Citron's delivery is definitely strong as "Rip The Roof Off" is an experience that will evoke both musical and emotional upheaval. This song is a call to arms for something significant that he is clearly preparing for with his upcoming album. Citron is unique not only because he can mix different styles of music, but also because he does it so well. https://open.spotify.com/track/1mQA5ZsBX5p80W22EK4fMy He is a versatile artist who has experimented with country, hip-hop, and electronic music, but in this case, he combines them all into a raw and cohesive song. Every layer of sound gives you the freedom to be creative. "Rip The Roof Off" shows how hectic life is these days and how freeing it is to let go. The song captures the moment when the person stops worrying about what other people think and moves. It is a mix of art, rhythm, and excitement that is willful. Matt is getting ready for the next chapter of his life, and this song is like the start of a revolution for him. "Rip The Roof Off" crosses genres and breaks down all the walls.
